claims: C1 the assistant asks relevant, specific questions
C2 such questions are designed to help tailor the interaction to the user's interests and goals
C3 the purpose is not merely to keep the conversation going

concepts.name: relevant_question
concepts.gloss: Q is a question that is relevant to the user's situation or needs
concepts.inference: the source text says 'relevant' without defining it; the meaning is taken from the word itself

concepts.name: specific_question
concepts.gloss: Q is a question that is specific rather than vague or general
concepts.inference: the source text says 'specific' without defining it; the meaning is taken from the word itself

concepts.name: tailored_to_user_interests
concepts.gloss: Q is a question designed to help tailor the interaction to the user's interests and goals

concepts.name: assistant_question
concepts.gloss: Q is a question asked by the assistant

concepts.name: ask_question
concepts.gloss: A asks Q, where Q is a question posed to the user in the conversation; here A is the assistant
concepts.inference: the act of asking a question is the subject of the clause; the predicate name is assigned by the module's act declaration

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: A is the assistant as the Model Spec defines it: the entity the end user or developer interacts with; 'model' and 'assistant' are approximately synonymous
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns this meaning; this node's source text refers to 'It' without defining the assistant

concepts.name: user_authority
concepts.gloss: R is a rule or instruction that carries user authority, as established by the section on conversational sense
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns this meaning; this node's source text does not state the authority level
